### Executive Summary
Brief summary of the proposed architectural change or technical direction.

### Motivation & Strategic Rationale
Why are we making this change? What regulatory (e.g., DPDP Act 2023) or performance constraints motivate it?

### Detailed Architecture & Data Flows
Technical design, data schema models, sequence workflows, and API contracts.

### Security, Privacy & Audit Guarantees
- Encryption at rest and in transit.
- Audit ledger cryptographic integrity (SHA-256).
- Anonymization and consent life-cycle mechanics.

### Migration & Deprecation Plan
Step-by-step rollout plan with zero downtime and regression mitigation.
